name: CubeStormer 3
def: Rubik's Cube solving robot made from Lego Mindstorms and a Samsung Galaxy S4 that set a world record of 3.253 seconds in March 2014.
facts: Solved a Rubik's Cube in 3.253 seconds on 15 March 2014 in Birmingham
Beat the previous record of 5.270 seconds, held by CubeStormer II
Built over 18 months by David Gilday and Mike Dobson
